name: Pick n Pay
verdict: Pick n Pay is the retail brand of JSE- and A2X-listed Pick n Pay Stores Limited, whose largest voting shareholder is the founding Ackerman family (36.8%). No state owner in the chain and no qualifying human-rights finding found. Nothing found.
note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of the Springboks: a four-year Tier 1 contract signed in March 2025 put the gold Pick n Pay logo on the back of the matchday jersey; it appears on the upper back of the 2026/27 home jersey. Rated in the rugby-south-africa rating sweep (issue #727).
